processes:task-fa-build-intake-b4u8zj.plain_language_name: Receive the Operational Data Sources for the Feeds
processes:task-fa-build-intake-b4u8zj.plain_language_description: Integration opens when the operational data sources are handed over as the wells the planning feeds will draw from. The intake custodian accepts them, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the laying from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-b4u8zj.business_purpose: It exists so the planning models drink from registered wells rather than from whatever spreadsheet is at hand.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-b4u8zj.practical_context: It opens when the data sources are presented for the feeds, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the finance function registers the operational data sources as the feed baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-fa-build-transform-xfxfgm.plain_language_name: Run the Pipes from Operations into the Planning Models
processes:task-fa-build-transform-xfxfgm.plain_language_description: With the sources verified, the processing custodian does the laying itself: the feeds that carry operational data into the planning models are built and proven, and the working integrations are set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-xfxfgm.business_purpose: It exists because a forecast built on hand-copied numbers is a forecast built on typos - the pipes are what keep the planning honest.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-xfxfgm.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified sources are ready to be piped from, and it ends with the working integrations produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the finance function lays and proves each feed from operations into the models, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-fa-build-verify-ebpgww.plain_language_name: Check the Sources Before Laying the Pipes
processes:task-fa-build-verify-ebpgww.plain_language_description: Before anything is piped, the verification custodian checks the data sources against what integration requires - that each source is authoritative for what it will feed. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before any pipe is laid.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-ebpgww.business_purpose: It exists so the models are never fed from wells that were never authoritative.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-ebpgww.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the sources can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a feed pointed at a shadow copy of the sales data and logs the defect before any pipe is laid.

processes:task-fa-build-record-bsbau9.plain_language_name: File the Readiness Determination Audit Record
processes:task-fa-build-record-bsbau9.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the proving trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What was exercised, against which structure and controls, stays readable whenever the readiness call is revisited.
processes:task-fa-build-record-bsbau9.business_purpose: It exists so the readiness judgement can be evidenced against the proof it was drawn from.
processes:task-fa-build-record-bsbau9.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the proving trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a readiness review would consult.

processes:task-fa-build-confirm-d9ns86.plain_language_description: When the proving stands done, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The operate budgeting that follows learns the systems are proven and the cycle may begin.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-d9ns86.business_purpose: It exists so budgeting runs only over systems proven ready by determination.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-d9ns86.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the readiness determination awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the readiness determination against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the operating cycle waits on.

processes:task-fa-build-intake-675pdz.plain_language_name: Receive the Built Systems for the Readiness Call
processes:task-fa-build-intake-675pdz.plain_language_description: Proving opens when the built systems are handed over as the whole whose readiness must be judged. The intake custodian accepts them, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the determination from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-675pdz.business_purpose: It exists so readiness is judged over the registered built whole rather than over optimism.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-675pdz.practical_context: It opens when the built systems are presented for the determination, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the built systems as the proving baseline, with audit references, and opens the readiness work.

processes:task-fa-build-transform-mx3hfs.plain_language_name: Prove the Planning Systems Ready for the Cycle
processes:task-fa-build-transform-mx3hfs.plain_language_description: With the build verified, the processing custodian does the proving itself: the systems are exercised against the plan structure and the fitted guard-rails, and the readiness determination is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-mx3hfs.business_purpose: It exists because a system that was never exercised is a promise nobody has tested - proving is where the cycle's foundation is shown to hold.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-mx3hfs.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified build is ready to be proven, and it ends with the readiness determination produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the finance function exercises the systems against the structure and controls and records the determination, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-fa-build-verify-bsuc4r.plain_language_name: Check the Build Before the Readiness Call
processes:task-fa-build-verify-bsuc4r.plain_language_description: Before anything is proven, the verification custodian checks the built systems against what proving requires - that models, controls, and integrations are all present and none arrived half-built. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the proving begins.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-bsuc4r.business_purpose: It exists so readiness is never declared over a build with pieces still missing.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-bsuc4r.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the build can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds an integration still unproven and logs the defect before the readiness call is made.

processes:task-fa-build-record-86quhg.plain_language_name: File the Posting Rules Audit Record
processes:task-fa-build-record-86quhg.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the configuration trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. How each transaction class was set to enter the books stays readable whenever an entry's route is examined.
processes:task-fa-build-record-86quhg.business_purpose: It exists so the rules behind every ledger entry can be evidenced whenever an entry's route is questioned.
processes:task-fa-build-record-86quhg.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the configuration trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a ledger review would consult.

processes:task-fa-build-confirm-upnzy8.plain_language_description: When the rules stand set, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The chart deployment that follows learns the entry logic is settled and the structure can go live over it.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-upnzy8.business_purpose: It exists so the ledger goes live only over rules confirmed as configured.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-upnzy8.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the configured rules await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the configured rules against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the chart deployment needs.

processes:task-fa-build-intake-5nkpc7.plain_language_name: Receive the Chart and the Controls for the Rules
processes:task-fa-build-intake-5nkpc7.plain_language_description: Configuration opens when the chart of accounts and the financial controls are handed over together as the frame the posting rules must be set within. The intake custodian accepts both, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the configuration from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-5nkpc7.business_purpose: It exists so entries are governed by rules set from the registered chart and controls.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-5nkpc7.practical_context: It opens when the chart and controls are presented for the configuration, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the finance function registers the chart and controls as the rule-setting baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-fa-build-transform-c9xmfy.plain_language_name: Set How Transactions Find Their Way into the Ledger
processes:task-fa-build-transform-c9xmfy.plain_language_description: With the frame verified, the processing custodian does the configuration itself: the rules that route each class of transaction to its ledger treatment are worked out and set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-c9xmfy.business_purpose: It exists because a ledger is only as trustworthy as its front door - the rules are what keep every entry arriving where it belongs.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-c9xmfy.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified frame is ready to be configured from, and it ends with the configured rules produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the finance function sets the routing for each class of transaction into the books, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-fa-build-verify-z532x3.plain_language_name: Check the Chart Before Setting the Rules
processes:task-fa-build-verify-z532x3.plain_language_description: Before anything is configured, the verification custodian checks the chart and controls against what configuration requires - that the chart is the committed one and the controls cover the entry paths the rules will open. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the rules are set.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-z532x3.business_purpose: It exists so no rule is set against a chart that was superseded.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-z532x3.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the frame can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the rules being set against a superseded chart and logs the defect before the configuration proceeds.

processes:task-fa-build-record-bwk7zj.plain_language_name: File the Chart Deployment Audit Record
processes:task-fa-build-record-bwk7zj.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the deployment trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. Which structure went live, in which systems, and when, stays readable whenever an account's standing is examined.
processes:task-fa-build-record-bwk7zj.business_purpose: It exists so the going-live of the account structure can be evidenced whenever an account's standing is questioned.
processes:task-fa-build-record-bwk7zj.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the deployment trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles an accounting review would consult.

processes:task-fa-build-confirm-8cwh9a.plain_language_name: Confirm the Deployed Chart of Accounts
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-8cwh9a.plain_language_description: When the structure stands live, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The report deployment that follows learns the account skeleton is up and reports can be built over it.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-8cwh9a.business_purpose: It exists so reports are built only over a chart confirmed as deployed.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-8cwh9a.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the deployed chart awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the deployed chart against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the report deployment needs.

processes:task-fa-build-intake-27peg5.plain_language_description: Deployment opens when the committed account structure is handed over as the skeleton the financial systems will live by. The intake custodian accepts it, registers it with audit identifiers, and starts the deployment from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-27peg5.business_purpose: It exists so the systems take their account structure from the committed design rather than from local habit.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-27peg5.practical_context: It opens when the committed structure is presented for deployment, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the finance function registers the committed account structure as the deployment baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-fa-build-transform-jf33mp.plain_language_name: Stand the Account Structure Up in the Systems
processes:task-fa-build-transform-jf33mp.plain_language_description: With the structure verified, the processing custodian does the deployment itself: the designed chart is stood up inside the financial systems and made live, and the deployed chart is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-jf33mp.business_purpose: It exists because a chart on paper classifies nothing - deployment is where the enterprise's financial language actually starts working.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-jf33mp.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified structure is ready to be stood up, and it ends with the deployed chart produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the finance function stands the designed account structure up live inside the systems, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-fa-build-verify-fqjmy6.plain_language_name: Check the Structure Before Standing It Up
processes:task-fa-build-verify-fqjmy6.plain_language_description: Before anything is deployed, the verification custodian checks the structure against what deployment requires - that every account in the design is stated and none is left ambiguous. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before any structure is stood up.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-fqjmy6.business_purpose: It exists so the systems never go live on a skeleton with missing bones.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-fqjmy6.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the structure can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds an account whose purpose is ambiguous and logs the defect before the structure is stood up.

processes:task-fa-build-record-tcr27x.plain_language_name: File the Report Deployment Audit Record
processes:task-fa-build-record-tcr27x.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the deployment trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. Which reports went live, against which requirements, stays readable whenever a disclosed figure is examined.
processes:task-fa-build-record-tcr27x.business_purpose: It exists so the deployment of each report can be evidenced whenever a disclosed figure is questioned.
processes:task-fa-build-record-tcr27x.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the deployment trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a reporting review would consult.

processes:task-fa-build-confirm-v363gv.plain_language_description: When the reports stand deployed, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The build closes with its reporting obligations met and the ledger able to speak.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-v363gv.business_purpose: It exists so the ledger is treated as complete only once its reports are confirmed as deployed.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-v363gv.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the deployed reports await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the deployed reports against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation that closes the build.

processes:task-fa-build-intake-q9uzcd.plain_language_name: Receive the Reporting Requirements and Disclosure Needs
processes:task-fa-build-intake-q9uzcd.plain_language_description: Report deployment opens when the reporting requirements and the disclosure needs are handed over as the obligations the reports must satisfy. The intake custodian accepts them, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the building from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-q9uzcd.business_purpose: It exists so reports are built against registered obligations rather than against whatever looks presentable.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-q9uzcd.practical_context: It opens when the requirements and disclosure needs are presented for the deployment, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the remaining steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the finance function registers the reporting requirements and disclosure needs as the deployment baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-fa-build-transform-kxbhz8.plain_language_name: Build the Reports the Ledger Owes
processes:task-fa-build-transform-kxbhz8.plain_language_description: With the requirements verified, the processing custodian does the building itself: each report the ledger owes - to management, to disclosure - is built over the deployed chart and made live, set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-kxbhz8.business_purpose: It exists because a ledger that cannot speak produces trust in nothing - the reports are where the books answer for themselves.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-kxbhz8.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified requirements are ready to be built from, and it ends with the deployed reports produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the finance function builds each owed report over the deployed chart and makes it live, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-fa-build-verify-aafzze.plain_language_name: Check the Requirements Before Building the Reports
processes:task-fa-build-verify-aafzze.plain_language_description: Before anything is built, the verification custodian checks the requirements against what deployment requires - that every obligation is stated and each maps to the chart's accounts. Gaps are logged for rejection or repair before any report is built.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-aafzze.business_purpose: It exists so no report is built that leaves an obligation unmet.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-aafzze.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the requirements can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their gaps logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a disclosure obligation with no mapped account and logs the gap before any report is built.
